subject: CityHack credit allocation and promo codes — distribution plan
messages:
From: Kara Nguyen <kara@cityhack.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CityHack Ops <ops@cityhack.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for 100 student promo codes for CityHack booth

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for agreeing to sponsor CityHack (Feb 14-16). We ran the outreach to student chapters and demand is higher than we expected — can Redwood provide 100 promo codes that give $50 in Redwood credits each (usable for hosted API + embeddings) for student teams? We also want 10 mentor codes with a 90-day extended trial for workshop leads.

What we need from you to finalize the distribution:
- A single CSV with 100 unique promo codes + 10 mentor codes (we’ll handle distribution).
- Expiry: codes live until May 1, 2026.
- Usage cap per code: single team redemption.
- A short link and UTM so we can track sign-ups (e.g., redwood.com/cityhack?utm_source=cityhack2026).

Deadline: we’d like codes by Jan 23 so we can print collateral and programmatically add them to our registration flow.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Kara Nguyen
Partnerships, CityHack
(attachment: CityHack-Sponsor-Request.pdf (PDF))

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Nguyen <kara@cityhack.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for 100 student promo codes for CityHack booth

Lauren / Dev — looping you in. Kara asked for 100 student $50 promo codes and 10 mentor codes with extended trials. The ask feels promotional/marketing but it’s large enough that we should confirm spend and any T&Cs.

My proposal:
- Approve 100 student codes @ $50 credit each (total $5,000 notional).
- 10 mentor codes with extended 90-day trial (no token cap for trial but capped to 30k tokens each).
- Codes expire 2026-05-01.
- We provide a CSV + a short tracking link.

Lauren — can Marketing confirm we have the budget under the events promo line?
Dev — can Legal confirm the redemption limits and if any contractual language or PO is needed from CityHack? If Legal wants to attach a simple promo T&C, I can forward it.

I can generate the codes once we have a green light. Kara — will that timeline still work for you (Jan 23 delivery)?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: —)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Nguyen <kara@cityhack.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for 100 student promo codes for CityHack booth

Jordan — I support this. CityHack has been a good funnel for student talent and we want the visibility. A couple notes from Marketing:
- Can we split the 100 pool into 80 public student codes + 20 reserved team-competition codes (for judges/PR)? Keeps some control.
- Please include a UTM and UTM-coded short link (we can do redwood.ai/cityhack2026) so analytics picks up conversions.
- For mentor codes, confirm we’ll require a short registration form before redemption so we can track mentor details.

Budget: confirm $5k comes from 2026 events/promo (approved).

Dev — any legal flags? If not, Jordan, proceed with code generation and include the per-code token cap in the CSV export.

Thanks — Lauren
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Nguyen <kara@cityhack.org>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for 100 student promo codes for CityHack booth

All — quick legal check complete. No need for a PO for a one-off promo under $10k. A few required items:
- Per-code redemption limit noted in the T&Cs (single team redemption).
- Expiry date present in CSV.
- We should include the following short clause in the promo T&C: "Promo codes are non-transferable, valid for one account only, and expire on the stated date. Redwood reserves the right to revoke credits in cases of abuse."

Jordan — you’re clear to generate the codes and deliver the CSV and short link. Please include the mentor code list separately and mark them in the CSV as "MENTOR". Kara — we’ll send the file to your ops email once ready.

—Dev
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(attachment: promo_codes.csv (CSV))
